KNOWN ISSUES:
- FHIR partner client credentials are accepted without mTLS or audience validation.
- Session tokens do not expire after a password change.
- Break-glass access is not audited separately.

known_issues.description: The upload S3 bucket policy permits public GetObject
known_issues.mitigation: Enable S3 Block Public Access and restrict bucket policies and object ACLs to explicit workload principals.

known_issues.description: The thumbnail Lambda execution role has AdministratorAccess
known_issues.mitigation: Remove AdministratorAccess and wildcard iam:PassRole; scope actions, resources, conditions, and passable role ARNs.

known_issues.description: The Lambda role can call kms:Decrypt on every key
known_issues.mitigation: Restrict kms:Decrypt to required key ARNs and enforce encryption-context and ViaService conditions.

known_issues.description: API Gateway has no request throttling
known_issues.mitigation: Enforce per-user and per-tenant rate, concurrency, payload, and cost limits with bounded queues and timeouts.

known_issues.description: SQS has no dead-letter queue and messages can be retried indefinitely
known_issues.mitigation: Bound retries, move poison messages to a dead-letter destination, alert operators, and make consumers idempotent.

known_issues.description: Presigned upload URLs do not restrict content type or object size
known_issues.mitigation: Use short-lived, principal-bound URLs with key-prefix, content-type, checksum, and object-size restrictions.

known_issues.description: The EKS Kubernetes API endpoint is publicly reachable from 0.0.0.0/0
known_issues.mitigation: Disable public cluster endpoint access or restrict it to approved administration networks with strong IAM and audit controls.

known_issues.description: One workload runs privileged with hostPath mounted
known_issues.mitigation: Disallow privileged containers and hostPath mounts using restricted Pod Security Admission and admission policy.

known_issues.description: Its IRSA policy allows s3:* on all resources
known_issues.mitigation: Bind each service account to a narrowly scoped IAM role with bucket, prefix, action, and condition restrictions.

known_issues.description: RDS is publicly accessible
known_issues.mitigation: Place RDS in private subnets, disable public accessibility, and restrict security groups to application workloads.

known_issues.description: ECR tags are mutable and image scanning is disabled
known_issues.mitigation: Use immutable digest references, enable registry scanning, sign artifacts, and enforce signature verification at admission.

known_issues.description: Database credentials are copied into plain environment variables
known_issues.mitigation: Inject short-lived secrets from a managed secret store and prevent plaintext credentials in manifests and environment dumps.

known_issues.description: Argo CD accepts unsigned deployment manifests
known_issues.mitigation: Require signed GitOps commits and manifests, verify provenance, and fail deployment when policy verification fails.

known_issues.description: Retrieved documents are inserted into the system prompt without separating instructions from data
known_issues.mitigation: Mark retrieved content as untrusted data, isolate instructions, constrain tool capabilities and independently authorize every action.

known_issues.description: Vector retrieval does not apply a tenant_id filter
known_issues.mitigation: Derive tenant scope from identity and enforce it in every retrieval query and vector-index authorization policy.

known_issues.description: The model can call a tool and its arguments are not schema validated
known_issues.mitigation: Expose typed allowlisted operations, validate every argument, authorize the caller and resource, and isolate execution.

known_issues.description: Full prompts, retrieved passages, access tokens, and model responses are written to logs
known_issues.mitigation: Remove sensitive payloads and credentials from logs, apply field-level redaction, restrict access, and shorten retention.

known_issues.description: The API trusts tenant IDs from JWT custom claims without verifying issuer-specific claim mappings
known_issues.mitigation: Validate issuer, audience, algorithm, and issuer-specific claim mappings before deriving tenant or authorization context.

known_issues.description: An image import endpoint fetches arbitrary user-supplied URLs from the EKS network
known_issues.mitigation: Allowlist destinations, block private and link-local addresses after DNS resolution, and isolate egress.

known_issues.description: The RAG retriever can return chunks belonging to another tenant
known_issues.mitigation: Derive tenant scope from identity and enforce it in every retrieval query and vector-index authorization policy.

known_issues.description: Retrieved content can instruct the agent to invoke MCP tools
known_issues.mitigation: Treat retrieved content as untrusted data, isolate it from instructions, and authorize every resulting action server-side.

known_issues.description: MCP tools inherit a shared service account with write access to every tenant
known_issues.mitigation: Use per-user or per-tenant delegated credentials with narrow scopes and authorize each MCP action independently.

known_issues.description: Azure OpenAI prompts include raw customer secrets and are logged
known_issues.mitigation: Remove sensitive payloads and credentials from logs, apply field-level redaction, restrict access, and shorten retention.
owasp_top_10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

known_issues.description: The EKS deployment role has wildcard iam:PassRole
known_issues.mitigation: Remove AdministratorAccess and wildcard iam:PassRole; scope actions, resources, conditions, and passable role ARNs.

known_issues.description: GitHub Actions uses unpinned third-party actions
known_issues.mitigation: Pin every action to an immutable commit SHA, review publishers, minimize workflow permissions and protect workflow changes.
owasp_top_10: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

known_issues.description: Stripe webhooks are processed without signature validation or idempotency
known_issues.mitigation: Verify provider signatures over the raw request body and enforce timestamp, replay, and idempotency controls.
owasp_top_10: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

known_issues.description: Deletion requests do not propagate to Pinecone, BigQuery, backups, or model evaluation datasets
known_issues.mitigation: Track deletion across primary stores, vectors, analytics, backups, caches, queues, and AI evaluation datasets.

known_issues.description: Cross-cloud data transfers are not represented in the audit trail
known_issues.mitigation: Record source identity, tenant, dataset, destination, purpose, and transfer result in correlated immutable audit events.
owasp_top_10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

known_issues.description: Kafka consumers retry poison messages without a dead-letter topic
known_issues.mitigation: Bound retries, move poison messages to a dead-letter destination, alert operators, and make consumers idempotent.
